newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end sharply down, outlook dim.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end sharply down, outlook dim.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures finished sharply lower on Wednesday as a number of bearish factors dragged down an already depressed market, dealers said.
"The market should continue to go down, but we could see a slight technical rebound tomorrow morning towards 20,800 before heading lower," said a trader with a Japanese futures house.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract lost 235 points to end at 20,675, only 35 points from its day low of 20,640.

Dealers said news of financial difficulties at a small Japanese regional bank provided a fresh selling incentive, while players remained bearish amid continuing uncertainty about the composition of Japan's new ruling coalition.
The trader with the Japanese house said the yen's recent decline against the dollar and other currencies was also being viewed as excessive and damaging to the equity market.
He said the December Nikkei would be supported at 20,550-20,600 but a break through that region could push it below 20,000.
